axes.concept: An operational personal-decoration register inside the existing Taller: identify a scene or piece, inspect it and place a copy without leaving the work surface.
axes.layout: Preserved Pictures/Sempertex masthead and horizontal Taller/Proyectos routes; 52px tool rail, 390px library and flexible scene/detail workspace. At phone width, Biblioteca/Escena exposes one workspace panel at a time.
axes.navigation: Existing product routes remain horizontal and neutral. Mi biblioteca is the owner entry; Otra cuenta and its owner selector appear only in the staff fixture. Search, type and occasion narrow the register; Filtros reveals colour and balloon controls.
axes.typography: Existing Geist Sans: 24px page title, 20px library and selected-item headings, 14px item names, 13px controls and 12px provenance. Existing Geist Mono is limited to Sempertex.
axes.density: Ruled compact records with 66px thumbnail columns and 16px vertical insets; no repeated large cards. Colour and balloon filters are disclosed on demand, with browser-local records in a separately labelled group.
axes.components: Installed shadcn/Base UI Button, Input and Skeleton; Animate UI-backed Dialog for name/occasion and AlertDialog for deletion. Existing native filter selects and details/account disclosure; custom static scene SVG is labelled Mockup.
axes.colour: Exact Pictures globals.css and finalised sibling token mappings: fondo/superficie/texto/acento plus existing Taller, success and error roles. No new palette or font; texto-tenue supplies accessible input edges.
axes.motion: Precise lateral registration: rows move 12px over 220ms with 40ms offsets and cubic-bezier(.77,0,.175,1); feedback enters laterally and confirmation marks settle over 360ms. Natural 170/24ms, subtle 120/12ms, 150ms hover/press. Reduced motion and still show final content immediately; hidden tabs pause CSS animation.
